title: •Dannik Jerriko
caption: •Dannik Jerriko (V)
lore: Anzati assassin. Cheek-folds hide proboscises which allow him to “eat the soup” (consume the life Force) of his victims. Smokes t’bac. Currently working for Jabba.
game_text: If present where you just won a battle, may use 1 Force to place a card from opponent’s Lost Pile out of play.
